info.name: Voting Service - API regression suite
info.description: Run the entire collection in order against a local/test instance. Uses in-memory H2 through the API and creates voting data; there is no delete endpoint. Set baseUrl (default http://localhost:8080). Folder 01 generates unique dates and IDs. See postman/README.md for coverage, prerequisites and CLI use.

item.name: 01 - Create fixtures and successful POST cases
item.description: Run this folder first. Generates fresh UTC dates and saves vote IDs. Creates boundary, attendance and majority fixtures through HTTP.

item.name: Create simple vote without earlier attendance (yes)

exec: // Only the first fixture starts a new run; all following requests reuse its dates and IDs.
// Choose an unused future day; no pre-existing data should be created inside this run's window.
// Choose test instants before all attendance fixtures, including those from prior runs.
const absentStart = previousAbsent ? Math.min(absentCandidate, previousAbsent - 3 * 86400000) : absentCandidate;

request.description: A simple-majority vote can be registered without earlier attendance. Expected HTTP 200.

item.name: Create simple vote without earlier attendance (no)

request.description: A simple-majority vote can be registered without earlier attendance. Expected HTTP 200.
Create an ISO-formatted timestamp derived from an epoch instant. Expected HTTP 200.

item.name: 02 - POST validation and failure atomicity
item.description: Each invalid request expects an explicit error contract. Uses a reserved timestamp so rejection is checked again by a final daily read.

request.description: 201 ballots exceed the maximum. Expected HTTP 400.
Chairperson missing from ballots. Expected HTTP 400.

item.name: Duplicate timestamp with equivalent UTC offset

request.description: Duplicate timestamp with equivalent UTC offset. Expected HTTP 400.

exec: pm.test("Specific error detail", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include("could not be parsed"));

request.description: Numeric epoch timestamp is not an ISO date-time string. Expected HTTP 400.

request.description: Wrong JSON type for szavazatok: invalid. Expected HTTP 400.

Wrong JSON type for elnok: []. Expected HTTP 400.
JSON array instead of object. Expected HTTP 400.

item.name: Reject invalid vote at recovery timestamp

request.description: Reject invalid vote at recovery timestamp. Expected HTTP 400.
Valid retry after rejected request. Expected HTTP 200.

item.name: 03 - GET representative vote
item.description: All three choices, URL encoding, missing parameters, unknown IDs and representatives.

request.description: Encoded Unicode and reserved characters. Expected HTTP 200.
Representative did not vote. Expected HTTP 404.
Representative codes are case-sensitive. Expected HTTP 404.

item.name: 04 - GET voting result
item.description: Exact counts; attendance is always accepted; strict simple and qualified majority thresholds; latest preceding attendance.

item.name: 05 - GET daily votes
item.description: Full response equality checks ordering, UTC boundaries, nested ballots, optional procedure omission and absence of rejected writes.
